decisions.reason: A height-adjustable executive desk system fits the strong ergonomic office trend, has its own page, and needs time to recoup its development investment.
A chair family is a core furniture line that complements the desk systems and is prominently presented.
Floor cushions made from carpets are a niche design item with uncertain demand, but they are cheap to keep and support the textile line.
The sofa is only mentioned on the website rather than featured, which suggests lower priority, but one year is too early to judge an upholstery product.
A high standing table suits modern office and meeting concepts and has its own dedicated page.
The rug collection is featured on its own page and likely shares materials with the floor cushions, which keeps marginal costs low.
